review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: First find the minimum number of boarded lines per station by BFS in the station-line incidence graph, expanding each line once. Every line connects stations at only its minimum level and that level plus one. Any prefix of a minimum-boarding route must itself use the minimum boardings to its station; otherwise replacement would improve the full route. Process lines in BFS level order and maximize minutes from level-d boarding stations to level-(d+1) destinations. Two linear sweeps compute max(best[u]+abs(position[v]-position[u])) for forward/backward riding without reversing on the same boarding. All lines of one level finish before the next, preserving dependency order. Parse the named routes and emit the requested singular/plural summary. Runtime is linear in total route length plus stations.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
